bottom_line: OFAC expands secondary sanctions targeting Iran's petrochemical and shipping networks, increasing compliance risk for intermediaries.
what_changed: New OFAC designations added 30+ entities to the SDN list, including shipping companies, port operators, and petrochemical traders facilitating Iranian exports.
why_it_matters: Intermediaries in UAE, Turkey, and Southeast Asia face direct designation risk; banks processing related transactions face secondary sanctions exposure.
main_uncertainty: Enforcement intensity against non-US intermediaries remains to be tested; some designated entities may reconstitute under new names.

scenarios.name: Aggressive enforcement
scenarios.description: OFAC pursues secondary sanctions cases against non-US banks within 6 months.

scenarios.name: Designation without follow-through
scenarios.description: Designations serve as deterrent but enforcement resources focus elsewhere.
indicators: No new enforcement actions within 12 months

watch_next: OFAC enforcement actions against non-US persons
